- 토큰이 비어 있으면 기록을 건너뜁니다.

label: CronusFarm Dashboard v2
info:
CronusFarm Dashboard (A~D Bed)

- 모니터 탭: Bed별 상태(R4 핀·TG 팬). C/D는 현재 펌웨어에 출력 미할당(예비)
- 설정 탭: 자동/수동(채널별) + 시간 설정(펌프 ON/OFF 분·초)

MQTT
- status: cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/status
- tele  : cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/tele
- cmd   : cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/cmd

DB 사용(권장 흐름)
- SQLite(정합·마스터): smartfarm.sqlite
- InfluxDB(시계열·Grafana): bucket CronusFarm
- 미러링(ETL): scripts/sqlite-to-influx.py  (sensor_readings → tele_db, 그 외 device_state/alerts/schedules 등)
- Grafana: InfluxDB(Flux)로 tele_db/device_state/device_run/alerts/schedules 조회

DEVICE_ID 기본: cronusfarm-01
Node-RED(피에서 실행) → 브로커: 127.0.0.1:1883 / 아두이노는 secrets.h 의 MQTT_HOST(예: ida… 또는 Pi LAN IP)

- tele(topic=led_*, pump_*)를 받아 타일 상태 동기화

format:
<style>
:root{
  --cf-bg:#0b1220;
  --cf-card:#0f1b31;
  --cf-text:#e6edf7;
  --cf-muted:#9db0cc;
  --cf-accent:#4f8cff;
  --cf-title:#FFD54F;
  --cf-pad-x:14px;
  --cf-pad-y:16px;
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-content{
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #070c15 0%, var(--cf-bg) 60%, #070c15 100%) !important;
  color: var(--cf-text) !important;
}

/* 카드 공통 */
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardpanel,
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template{
  background: var(--cf-card) !important;
  border-radius: 14px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35) !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06) !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme md-card-content{
  padding: var(--cf-pad-y) var(--cf-pad-x) !important;
}
/* 그룹 카드: 하단 여백(과한 세로 빈칸 완화) */
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group md-card-content{
  padding-top: 12px !important;
  padding-bottom: 12px !important;
}
/* 그룹 제목 아래 이중 구분선 완화(Farm 환경 등) */
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group md-card .md-toolbar-tools{
  border-bottom: none !important;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group md-card > md-card-content{
  border-top: none !important;
}
/* Farm 환경: 한 행 전체 폭 (z-index 사용 안 함 — Arduino 카드 제목이 가려지지 않게) */
body.nr-dashboard-theme md-card:has(.cf-fe-wide){
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  flex: 0 0 100% !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
body.nr-dashboard-theme .layout-wrap > md-card:has(.cf-fe-wide){
  flex-basis: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
}

.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardpanel .md-title{ color: var(--cf-text) !important; font-weight: 700 !important; }

/* 카드(그룹) 제목 — 모니터/설정 공통(검정으로 보이는 문제 강제 오버라이드) */
body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group .nr-dashboard-cardtitle,
body.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardpanel .md-toolbar-tools .md-toolbar-tools-title,
.nrdb-ui-group__title, .nrdb-ui-group-title,
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group-title,
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-group .nr-dashboard-group-title{
  color: var(--cf-title) !important;
  font-weight: 900 !important;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.65);
}

.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-cardpanel .md-subhead{ color: var(--cf-muted) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch .md-bar{ opacity:.75; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.md-checked .md-bar{ background: rgba(79,140,255,.55) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.md-checked .md-thumb{ background: var(--cf-accent) !important; }

/* 자동/수동 모드 스위치: ON=자동(녹색), OFF=수동(빨강) */
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.cf-mode .md-bar{ background: rgba(220,53,69,.45) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.cf-mode .md-thumb{ background: rgba(220,53,69,1) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.cf-mode.md-checked .md-bar{ background: rgba(40,167,69,.55) !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme md-switch.cf-mode.md-checked .md-thumb{ background: rgba(40,167,69,1) !important; }

/* raw text blocks (status/tele/cmd): wrap + thin font + scroll */
.cf-raw{ width:100%; }
.cf-raw.cf-raw-tight .cf-raw-title{ margin-top:0 !important; margin-bottom:2px !important; padding:0 !important; line-height:1.2 !important; }
.cf-raw.cf-raw-tight pre{ min-height:0 !important; }
.cf-raw-title{ color: var(--cf-muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 4px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 2px 0; }
.cf-raw pre{
  margin:0;
  padding:10px 12px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: var(--cf-text);
  font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.35;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  max-height: 140px;
  overflow: auto;
}
.cf-raw.cf-raw-compact .cf-raw-title{ margin-top:0; margin-bottom:2px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.25; padding:0; }
.cf-raw.cf-raw-telefit{ margin-bottom: 0 !important; }
.cf-raw.cf-raw-telefit .cf-raw-title{ margin-top:0 !important; margin-bottom:2px !important; line-height:1.25 !important; padding:0 !important; }
/* tele(raw): 전체 폭 + 내용 높이 기준 */
.cf-raw.cf-raw-telefit pre,
.cf-tele-raw-ui .cf-tele-raw-pre{
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  max-height: min(85vh, 52rem) !important;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 8px 10px !important;
  white-space: pre-wrap !important;
  word-break: break-word !important;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere !important;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  overflow-x: auto !important;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.nr-dashboard-theme .nr-dashboard-template:has(.cf-raw-telefit){ min-height: 0 !important; }
/* 모니터 탭 A/B Bed만 높이 통일 · C/D Bed는 채널 수 적음 → 강제 최소 높이 없음 */
.nr-dashboard-theme .layout-wrap{ align-items: stretch !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme .layout-wrap > md-card:nth-child(-n+2) md-card,
.nr-dashboard-theme .layout-wrap > md-card:nth-child(-n+2) .nr-dashboard-cardpanel{
  min-height: 520px;
}
.cf-raw.cf-raw-compact pre{
  min-height:0;
  max-height:min(28vh,12rem);
  line-height:1.45;
  white-space:pre-wrap;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  overflow-x:auto;
  overflow-y:auto;
  padding:8px 10px;
  font-size:11px;
  box-sizing:border-box;
}
/* status/cmd 한 줄 미리보기: Tiles CSS overflow:hidden이 글자를 잘라먹지 않도록 */
.nr-dashboard-theme md-card:has(.cf-raw),
.nr-dashboard-theme md-card-content:has(.cf-raw){
  overflow: visible !important;
}

/* tele 요약 + 보조 텍스트 */
.cf-muted{ color: var(--cf-muted); font-size: 11px; }
.cf-tele-preview{ width:100%; margin-top: 6px; }

.cf-raw.cf-raw-led pre.cf-led-pre,

  padding:8px 10px;

/* HomeKit 스타일(Glassmorphism) — Dashboard 2(@flowfuse, Vuetify) + Dashboard 1 fallback */

- InfluxDB: 시간축 데이터(센서/장치상태/알림/AI)를 저장. bucket은 CronusFarm 권장.
- SQLite: 관계형(작물/스케줄/이미지/AI 메타/이벤트). Grafana에서 직접 조회하려면 플러그인이 필요하므로, 기본 구성에서는 Node-RED가 Influx에도 같이 저장하는 방식 권장.

통신 방식 추천(Arduino → Node-RED): MQTT(추천)
- 장점: 저전력·유지형(retain) 상태, publish/subscribe로 확장 쉬움, 연결 끊김 복구에 강함
- 토픽 예: cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/tele, cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/cmd

name: 아키텍처 요약
label: 구성요소 역할 / 데이터 흐름(요약)
format:
Arduino(센서/릴레이) → Node-RED(수집·정규화·저장·제어 API) → InfluxDB(시계열: tele/alert_events/ai_detections) → Grafana(시각화/알림)

- InfluxDB: 시간축 데이터(센서/장치상태/알림/AI)를 저장. bucket은 CronusFarm 권장.
- SQLite: 관계형(작물/스케줄/이미지/AI 메타/이벤트). Grafana에서 직접 조회하려면 플러그인이 필요하므로, 기본 구성에서는 Node-RED가 Influx에도 같이 저장하는 방식 권장.

통신 방식 추천(Arduino → Node-RED): MQTT(추천)
- 장점: 저전력·유지형(retain) 상태, publish/subscribe로 확장 쉬움, 연결 끊김 복구에 강함
- 토픽 예: cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/tele, cronusfarm/<DEVICE_ID>/cmd
